mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (id, user_id, name,title,knowledge_point,source,material_id,s_material_id, removed,create_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{title}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{source}, #{materialId}, #{sMaterialId}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name,title,knowledge_point,source,material_id,s_material_id, removed,create_time FROM project WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND removed=0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, name,title,knowledge_point,source,material_id,s_material_id, removed,create_time FROM project WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id, user_id, name,title,knowledge_point,source,material_id,s_material_id, removed,create_time FROM project WHERE material_id=#{materialId}
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET removed=1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.title AS title, p.knowledge_point AS knowledge_point, p.create_time AS create_time, 'Material' AS type, m.`status` AS `status` FROM project p LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.id = p.material_id WHERE p.source = 'Material' AND p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.removed=0
UNION ALL
SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.title AS title, p.knowledge_point AS knowledge_point, p.create_time AS create_time, 'Collection' AS type, 'DONE' AS `status` FROM project p LEFT JOIN s_material sm ON p.s_material_id = sm.id WHERE p.source = 'Collection' AND p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.removed=0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
